proposed.explanation: 5 lux is insufficient for safe evacuation and does not meet regulatory requirements. 20 lux exceeds the minimum required standard; while acceptable, 10 lux is the baseline threshold. 30 lux is above the minimum emergency lighting requirement. The Philippine Electrical Code (PEC) Part 7 establishes that emergency lighting systems must maintain a minimum illumination level of 10 lux throughout evacuation routes and exit areas. This illumination level enables safe movement and wayfinding during fire emergencies when normal lighting may fail. This numerical standard is critical for life safety compliance. Emergency lighting must maintain 10 lux minimum per PEC Part 7; this is a foundational life safety numerical standard.
